title: Fix dashboard stories schema and SchemaRenderer prop spreading
body:
## Fix Storybook Dashboard Component Blank Display

### Problem
The Storybook dashboard component (storybook dashboard 组件) was displaying as blank due to two issues:

1. **Incorrect Schema Structure**: The dashboard stories used `children` array instead of the `widgets` array required by the `DashboardSchema` type
2. **Incomplete Prop Spreading**: The `SchemaRenderer` component in `@object-ui/react` only spread `schema.props` instead of the entire schema object, preventing components from receiving props like `label` and `value`

### Root Cause Analysis

The `DashboardRenderer` expects a `widgets` array where each widget has:
- `id`: Unique identifier
- `title`: Optional title for the widget
- `component`: The actual schema to render (e.g., metric, card)

The original stories incorrectly passed components directly as `children`, causing no widgets to be rendered.

Additionally, the `SchemaRenderer` was only spreading `schema.props`, but many components (like `MetricWidget`) expect their props directly on the schema object (e.g., `{ type: 'metric', label: 'Total Revenue', value: '$45,231.89' }`).

### Changes Made

#### 1. Fixed `packages/components/src/stories-json/dashboard.stories.tsx`
- ✅ Changed `children` array to `widgets` array
- ✅ Wrapped each component in proper widget structure with `id` and `component` properties
- ✅ Added widget titles for the "WithCards" story
- ✅ Updated both "Default" and "WithCards" stories

#### 2. Fixed `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`
- ✅ Added spreading of schema properties while excluding metadata (first commit)
- ✅ Fixed React error by properly filtering out schema metadata properties like `children`, `body`, `type`, etc. that should NOT be passed as React props (second commit)
- ✅ Maintains backward compatibility with explicit `props` object
- ✅ Allows components to receive props directly from schema (e.g., `label`, `value`)

### Screenshots

**Dashboard - Default Story (3 Metric Cards):**
![Dashboard Default](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5af18085-145a-4528-bbe9-f334ceddf574)

**Page Story - Now Working Without Errors:**
![Page Story Fixed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7143d037-abe8-44a7-b18b-67ea5b36b760)

### Testing
- ✅ Verified Default dashboard story displays three metric cards with correct labels and values
- ✅ Verified WithCards dashboard story displays two titled cards with nested metrics
- ✅ Verified Page story now renders without React errors
- ✅ Manually tested in Storybook at http://localhost:6006
- ✅ No security vulnerabilities found (CodeQL scan passed)

### Files Changed
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/dashboard.stories.tsx` (schema structure fix)
- `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` (prop spreading fix with metadata filtering)

### Security Summary
No security vulnerabilities discovered or introduced by these changes.
